level: stop-fence slice 5, explicit unknown fs_write reconciliation bound to original operation digest and exact current file bytes; component evidence only
componentAcceptance: reconcileMigrationRemoteFileEffect requires a revoked declared client, an unknown original fs_write and the exact original client/Bot/Task/attempt/tool/args digest. It independently reads the target file and requires byte equality with the original content. Success writes only a separate migration_operation_resolutions proof; the original operation stays unknown and no in-process-write receipt is forged. Drain revalidates proof identity and current bytes every time, so later tampering becomes unresolved again. Wrong content and wrong attempt/digest cannot create proof. In the real E102 crash scenario, two UNRESOLVED attempts precede explicit reconciliation; only then does resume complete drain and enter capture while the original operation remains unknown. The related combination is 40 tests / 39 pass / 0 fail / 1 skipped.
productAcceptance: None. This is a narrow file-effect proof for declared operations, not automatic Host Task reconciliation, cross-domain consistency or all-domain stop-write. Scores remain 0/20, 1/63 and M0 11/12; stopWriteProvable, activationSupported and postActivationRollbackSupported remain false.
implementation: The resolver recomputes the production operation digest from the declared original context and args, then compares it with the real operations row and stored context.
Only a revoked client and an unknown fs_write are eligible. The actual file must be a regular bounded file inside the declared physical root and exactly equal to the original UTF-8 content.
A separate proof records operation identity, digest, machine/client, root-relative file identity, SHA-256 and size. Repeating identical evidence is idempotent; conflicting evidence is rejected.
Drain accepts an unknown operation only while that separate proof remains valid against the current file. It never rewrites the original status or manufactures an Agent stop receipt.
The real crashed-Agent integration performs explicit reconciliation after two blocked attempts and then completes capture. The original status remains unknown after success.
testRuns: Resolver exact bytes/idempotence/tamper, wrong bytes and wrong digest tests plus real Store drain and full orchestration: 40 tests / 39 pass / 0 fail / 1 skipped.
Focused real crashed-Agent scenario with explicit reconciliation: three consecutive runs, each 1 test / 1 pass / 0 fail.
Final npm test: phase one 1590/1586/0/4 and phase two 364/284/0/80; total 1953 tests, 1871 pass, 0 fail, 84 skipped.
limitations: Only create-only UTF-8 fs_write effects with exact original args and content are supported. Other tools, arbitrary overwrite history and non-file effects remain unresolved.
The proof does not automatically settle the Host Task or other data domains and does not establish a cross-domain consistency point.
The file is revalidated, but unknown external OS writers and a global stop-write fence remain separate requirements.
No real user profile, model inference, production process, push or release was used.
